entities.name: Jardin botanique de l'Evêché
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jardin botanique de l'Evêché, also known as the Jardin botanique de Limoges, is a botanical garden located behind the Cathedral and Musée de l'Evêché in Limoges, Haute-Vienne, Limousin, France. It is open daily without charge.
